north_bengal.name: North Bengal (Hills, Dooars, Terai & Northern Plains)
north_bengal.name_bengali: উত্তরবঙ্গ (পাহাড়, ডুয়ার্স, তরাই ও উত্তর সমভূমি)
north_bengal.terrain_type: Himalayan foothill hills, Dooars tea gardens, Terai alluvial floodplains
north_bengal.climate_summary: Sub-tropical humid with heavy monsoon rainfall (2000-3500 mm)

gangetic_plain.name: Gangetic Alluvial Plains
gangetic_plain.terrain_type: Flat, extremely fertile alluvial deltaic plains and floodplain basins
gangetic_plain.climate_summary: Tropical savanna climate with distinct summer, monsoon and winter seasons
hazards: Seasonal monsoon waterlogging in low-lying beels

rarh_plateau.name: Rarh Plateau & Red Laterite Tracts
rarh_plateau.name_bengali: রাঢ় সমভূমি ও পশ্চিমের মালভূমি অঞ্চল
rarh_plateau.terrain_type: Undulating plateau fringe, laterite red soil (লাল মাটি), residual hills (Ayodhya, Susunia, Biharinath)
rarh_plateau.climate_summary: Semi-arid continental tropical; hot dry summers (up to 45°C), erratic monsoon (1100-1400 mm)

sundarbans_delta.name: Sundarbans Estuarine Mangrove Delta
sundarbans_delta.name_bengali: সুন্দরবন উপকূলীয় খাঁড়ি ও ম্যানগ্রোভ বদ্বীপ
sundarbans_delta.terrain_type: Active estuarine delta, dense mangrove forests, tidal mudflats, river islands (দ্বীপ)
sundarbans_delta.climate_summary: Maritime tropical monsoon with severe cyclone vulnerability and high humidity
primary_crops: Salt-tolerant Paddy (লবণাক্ততা সহনশীল ধান: হ্যামিল্টন, দুধেশ্বর)
hazards: Saline embankment breaches (নদীর বাঁধ ভাঙা ও নোনা জল ঢোকা)

kolkata_metro.name: Kolkata Metropolitan & Urban Core
kolkata_metro.name_bengali: কলকাতা মহানগর ও নগর সংলগ্ন অঞ্চল
kolkata_metro.terrain_type: High-density urbanized riverine metropolis along the lower Hooghly river
kolkata_metro.climate_summary: Tropical wet-and-dry climate tempered by maritime proximity
primary_crops: Urban green belt horticulture in peri-urban fringes
cultural_markers: Football derby: Mohun Bagan vs East Bengal

medinipur_coastal.name: Medinipur Coastal & Southern Alluvial Belt
medinipur_coastal.name_bengali: মেদিনীপুর উপকূল ও দক্ষিণ পলল অঞ্চল
medinipur_coastal.terrain_type: Coastal sand dunes, marine shorelines, estuarine wetlands, transition to alluvial plain
medinipur_coastal.climate_summary: Coastal maritime monsoon with sea breezes and seasonal depression showers
primary_crops: Betel vine (পান বরজ - তমলুক ও কাঁথি)
cultural_markers: Patuapara scroll painting (পটের গান ও পটচিত্র - পিংলা)
Mat weaving / Madur Kathi (মাদুর কাঠি - সবং)

local_entities.name_bengali: চা বাগান (Tea Garden)
local_entities.description: Terraced and flat tea plantations across Darjeeling, Terai, and Dooars.

authenticity.note: Universal across Darjeeling, Jalpaiguri, and Alipurduar school contexts.

local_entities.name_bengali: বড় এলাচ (Large Cardamom)
local_entities.description: High-altitude spice crop grown in shady hill valleys of Kalimpong and Darjeeling.

authenticity.note: Primary indigenous cash crop of Kalimpong and Darjeeling hill farmers.

local_entities.name_bengali: দার্জিলিং কমলালেবু (Darjeeling Mandarin Orange)
local_entities.description: Small, sweet, loose-skinned mandarin oranges grown in Mirik, Sittong, and Kalimpong.

authenticity.note: Quintessential North Bengal hill winter fruit.

local_entities.name_bengali: বুনো হাতির করিডোর (Wild Elephant Migration Corridor)
local_entities.description: Seasonal elephant movement pathways across Dooars tea estates connecting Jaldapara, Gorumara, and Buxa.

authenticity.note: Key ecology and safety theme in Dooars school curricula.

local_entities.name_bengali: দার্জিলিং হিমালয়ান রেলওয়ে খেলনা ট্রেন (Toy Train - DHR)
local_entities.description: Narrow-gauge mountain railway (UNESCO World Heritage Site) climbing from New Jalpaiguri to Darjeeling.

authenticity.note: Foundational physics and history teaching anchor in North Bengal.

local_entities.name_bengali: ভাওয়াইয়া গান ও দোতারা (Bhawaiya Folk Song & Dotara)
local_entities.description: Traditional melodious folk song form of Rajbanshi culture in Cooch Behar and Jalpaiguri accompanied by Dotara.

authenticity.note: Primary music and cultural marker across North Bengal plains.

local_entities.name_bengali: গোমীরা নাচের কাঠের মুখোশ (Gomira Wooden Mask)
local_entities.description: Ritual wooden dance masks carved from Gamari wood in Dinajpur villages (Kushmandi).

authenticity.note: Kushmandi Gomira craft is a recognized geographical heritage of Dakshin Dinajpur.

local_entities.name_bengali: মালদহের ফজলি ও ল্যাংড়া আম (Malda Fazli Mango)
local_entities.description: Large sweet late-maturing mango variety grown in extensive orchards along the Mahananda river in Malda.

authenticity.note: Renowned across Bengal and integral to Class 6-10 geography.

local_entities.name_bengali: সোনালী আঁশ পাট ও পাট জাগ দেওয়া (Golden Fiber Jute & Retting)
local_entities.description: Major monsoon bast fiber crop retted in ponds and canals across Murshidabad, Nadia, and Hooghly.

authenticity.note: Foundational biology/agriculture anchor in WBBSE science textbooks.

local_entities.name_bengali: আমন ধান ও ধানের গোলা (Aman Paddy & Traditional Granary)
local_entities.description: Primary monsoon staple paddy crop of Bengal, stored in cylindrical straw-and-bamboo granaries (গোলা).

authenticity.note: Universal staple agricultural concept throughout West Bengal.

local_entities.name_bengali: হুগলি ও বর্ধমানের আলু এবং কোল্ড স্টোরেজ (Potato Cold Storage)
local_entities.description: Extensive winter tuber farming in Hooghly and Purba Bardhaman stored in cooperative cold storages.

authenticity.note: Central math and economics problem-solving anchor in WBBSE arithmetic.

local_entities.name_bengali: বালুচরী ও তন্তুজ শাড়ি (Baluchari Silk Weaving)
local_entities.description: Intricate silk weaving depicting mythological narratives on saree pallus, originating in Baluchar, Murshidabad (and Bishnupur).

authenticity.note: Primary historical craft study in WBBSE history.

local_entities.name_bengali: বর্ধমানের মিহিদানা ও সীতাভোগ (Mihidana & Sitabhog of Bardhaman)
local_entities.description: GI-tagged heritage Bengali sweets made from Govindabhog rice flour and Chhana in Purba Bardhaman.

authenticity.note: Standard authentic cultural reference across Central Bengal.

local_entities.name_bengali: ঘূর্ণির মাটির পুতুল (Krishnanagar Clay Sculptures & Dolls)
local_entities.description: Exquisitely realistic clay figurines and miniature fruits/vegetables crafted by traditional potters of Ghurni, Nadia.

authenticity.note: Renowned art and craft topic in Class 6-8 creative education.

local_entities.name_bengali: দামোদর উপত্যকা সেচ খাল (DVC Irrigation Canal Network)
local_entities.description: Engineered canal irrigation network diverting water from Durgapur barrage into farms of Bardhaman, Hooghly, and Howrah.

authenticity.note: Classic textbook anchor for river valley projects and physics of water flow.

local_entities.name_bengali: চন্দননগরের আলোকসজ্জা (Chandannagar Dynamic Illumination)
local_entities.description: World-famous dynamic motorized LED and miniature bulb light displays crafted for Jagaddhatri Puja in Chandannagar.

authenticity.note: Excellent real-world physics/electricity anchor in WBBSE science.

local_entities.name_bengali: পুরুলিয়ার ছৌ নাচ ও মুখোশ (Purulia Chhau Dance & Mask)
local_entities.description: Acrobatic martial folk dance of Purulia where performers wear ornate paper-mache masks from Charida village.

authenticity.note: Foremost cultural anchor of western West Bengal.

local_entities.name_bengali: বাঁকুড়ার পোড়ামাটির ঘোড়া (Bankura Terracotta Horse)
local_entities.description: Traditional terracotta horse with erect ears and arched neck handcrafted by Kumbhakar artisans of Panchmura.

authenticity.note: Official symbol of all Indian handicrafts and pride of Bankura.

local_entities.name_bengali: শাল বন ও শালপাতার থালা (Sal Forest & Leaf Plates)
local_entities.description: Deciduous Sal (Shorea robusta) forests covering Junglemahal; leaves stitched into eco-friendly dining plates (শালপাতা).

authenticity.note: Primary ecology and economic livelihood anchor in Purulia, Bankura, and Jhargram.

local_entities.name_bengali: ডোকরা পেটা পিতল শিল্প (Dokra Lost-Wax Metal Craft)
local_entities.description: Ancient non-ferrous lost-wax metal casting technique practiced in Bikna (Bankura) and Dariyapur (Purba Bardhaman).

authenticity.note: Standard metallurgical and history textbook reference.

local_entities.name_bengali: শান্তিনিকেতনের খোয়াই ও সোনাঝুরি (Khoai Badlands & Sonajhuri Haat)
local_entities.description: Gullied canyon-like laterite badland topography created by wind and rain erosion along the Kopai river in Birbhum.

authenticity.note: Uniquely iconic geological and literary landmark in Bengali textbooks.

local_entities.name_bengali: শান্তিনিকেতনি কাঁথা স্টিচ (Santiniketan Nakshi Kantha Embroidery)
local_entities.description: Traditional running stitch embroidery repurposing layered cloth into ornate quilts, shawls, and sarees (GI Tag).

authenticity.note: Statewide recognized craft tradition with primary production in Birbhum.

local_entities.name_bengali: রাণীগঞ্জ ও আসানসোল কয়লাখনি (Raniganj Coalfield & Pithead)
local_entities.description: Birthplace of Indian coal mining (1774) situated along the Damodar valley in Paschim Bardhaman.

authenticity.note: Central energy, geology, and economic geography anchor in Class 9-10 syllabus.

local_entities.name_bengali: মাইথন ও পাঞ্চেত জলবিদ্যুৎ বাঁধ (Maithon & Panchet Hydro Dams)
local_entities.description: Major multipurpose river valley dams built across the Barakar and Damodar rivers for flood control and hydroelectricity.

authenticity.note: Primary physical science and geography anchor for potential-to-kinetic energy conversion.

local_entities.name_bengali: সুন্দরী গাছ ও শ্বাসমূল (Sundari Mangrove Tree & Pneumatophores)
local_entities.description: Halophytic mangrove tree (Heritiera fomes) adapted to tidal salinity with upright aerial breathing roots (শ্বাসমূল).

authenticity.note: Fundamental Life Science Class 9-10 plant adaptation anchor in WBBSE.

local_entities.name_bengali: রয়্যাল বেঙ্গল টাইগার (Royal Bengal Tiger of Sundarbans)
local_entities.description: Apex predator of the mangrove delta adapted to swimming across wide tidal creeks and living in saline swamps.

authenticity.note: National animal and key ecology/food web concept in school biology.

local_entities.name_bengali: মৌয়ালদের সুন্দরবনের মধু সংগ্রহ (Sundarban Wild Honey Gathering)
local_entities.description: Traditional forest honeycomb gathering in deep mangrove core by indigenous honey-collectors (মৌয়াল) during Chaitra-Baisakh.

authenticity.note: Iconic cultural and biodiversity topic in Bengali language readers.

local_entities.name_bengali: সুন্দরবনের নদীর মাটির বাঁধ (Tidal Earthen Embankment)
local_entities.description: Over 3,500 km of hand-packed earthen river dykes protecting low-lying human habitations from 6-meter daily tides.

authenticity.note: Crucial geography and disaster management anchor.

local_entities.name_bengali: বাগদা চিংড়ির ভেরি (Brackish Water Shrimp Bheri)
local_entities.description: Inundated shallow brackish aquaculture ponds used for farming export-grade Black Tiger Prawns (বাগদা).

authenticity.note: Standard real-life biology/economics example in coastal districts.

local_entities.name_bengali: গাঙের খেয়া নৌকা ও ভুটভুটি (River Ferry Boat & Bhutbhuti)
local_entities.description: Wooden passenger ferry boats and motorized shallow-draft vessels connecting roadless river islands across wide creeks.

authenticity.note: Used daily by thousands of school students in South and North 24 Parganas.

local_entities.name_bengali: মা বনবিবির পালাগান (Bonbibi Folk Theater & Ritual)
local_entities.description: Syncretic folk theatrical tradition worshipped equally by Hindu and Muslim forest-goers before entering the mangrove forest.

authenticity.note: Celebrated sociology and folk literature chapter in Bengal.

local_entities.name_bengali: দুধেশ্বর ও লবণাক্ততা-সহনশীল ধান (Dudheswar Indigenous Rice)
local_entities.description: Indigenous aromatic fine white rice variety traditionally cultivated in coastal Sundarbans with high flood tolerance.

authenticity.note: Renowned indigenous agricultural variety preserved in coastal farms.

local_entities.name_bengali: কলকাতার ট্রাম (Kolkata Electric Tramway)
local_entities.description: Asia's oldest operating electric streetcar system (since 1873), running on dedicated street-level tracks with overhead electric cables.

authenticity.note: Classic physics (current electricity, friction, kinematics) anchor.

local_entities.name_bengali: হাওড়া ব্রিজ / রবীন্দ্র সেতু (Howrah Bridge - Balanced Cantilever)
local_entities.description: Iconic steel balanced-cantilever truss bridge without nuts and bolts, riveted together across the Hooghly river.

authenticity.note: Premier physics and engineering case study in West Bengal syllabus.

local_entities.name_bengali: গঙ্গার নিচের মেট্রো রেল (Kolkata Underwater Metro Tunnel)
local_entities.description: India's first underwater transportation tunnel carrying Metro trains 32 meters beneath the Hooghly river bed.

authenticity.note: Contemporary science and physics teaching anchor.

local_entities.name_bengali: কলেজ স্ট্রিট বইপাড়া ও কফি হাউস (College Street Boi Para & Coffee House)
local_entities.description: World's largest secondhand book market stretching around Calcutta University and Presidency College.

authenticity.note: Central cultural anchor for all Bengali education literature.

local_entities.name_bengali: পূর্ব কলকাতা জলাভূমি (East Kolkata Wetlands - Ramsar Site)
local_entities.description: World-renowned natural ecological wetland system naturally treating the city's municipal wastewater via sunshine, algae, and fishponds.

authenticity.note: Core Environmental Studies (পরিবেশ বিজ্ঞান) case study in WB textbooks.

local_entities.name_bengali: দুর্গাপূজার মণ্ডপ ও আলোকশিল্প (Durga Puja Community Pandal Art)
local_entities.description: UNESCO-inscribed grand community cultural carnival featuring temporary architectural bamboo-and-cloth pandal installations and clay idols from Kumartuli.

authenticity.note: Universal cultural festival across all 23 districts.

local_entities.name_bengali: বাংলার রসগোল্লা ও নলেন গুড়ের মিষ্টি (Banglar Rosogolla & Nolen Gur)
local_entities.description: Spongy, syrupy sweet made from pure cow milk Chhana, invented by Nobin Chandra Das in Kolkata (GI Tag).

authenticity.note: Excellent math/physics anchor for buoyancy, capillary action, and volume.

local_entities.name_bengali: গঙ্গার ফেরি সার্ভিস (Ganges Passenger Ferry)
local_entities.description: Network of municipal river steamboats and twin-deck ferries connecting 30+ ghats between Kolkata and Howrah.

authenticity.note: Standard riverine speed and velocity math problem in textbooks.

local_entities.name_bengali: তমলুকের পান বরজ ও মিষ্টি পান (Tamluk Betel Vine Boroj)
local_entities.description: Shaded microclimate thatched bamboo and jute-stick enclosures used to cultivate delicate Mitha Paan (GI Tag).

authenticity.note: Key agricultural landmark in Purba Medinipur.

local_entities.name_bengali: দিঘা ও কাঁথির কাজু বাদাম (Digha Coastal Cashew Plantation)
local_entities.description: Cashew tree plantations stabilizing coastal sand dunes along Digha, Mandarmoni, and Ramnagar shorelines.

authenticity.note: Primary economic botany anchor in southern Bengal.

local_entities.name_bengali: সবংয়ের মাদুর কাঠি ও শীতল মাদুর (Sabang Madur Kathi Mat Weaving)
local_entities.description: Natural reed grass (Cyperus tegetum) cultivated and hand-woven into smooth, cooling floor mats in Sabang (GI Tag).

authenticity.note: Famous GI-tagged cottage industry of Paschim Medinipur.

local_entities.name_bengali: পিংলার পটচিত্র ও পটের গান (Pingla Patachitra Scroll Art)
local_entities.description: Ancient visual storytelling tradition of scroll painting using natural vegetable dyes, accompanied by narrative songs (পটের গান).

authenticity.note: Standard art and cultural history chapter in WBBSE curriculum.

local_entities.name_bengali: কোলাঘাটের রূপনারায়ণ তীরবর্তী ফুল চাষ (Kolaghat Floriculture & Flower Market)
local_entities.description: Vast commercial cultivation of Marigold (গাঁদা), Tuberose (রজনীগন্ধা), and Rose along the Rupnarayan riverbanks in Purba Medinipur.

authenticity.note: Prime real-life math/arithmetic transaction scenario in school textbooks.

local_entities.name_bengali: হলদিয়া আন্তর্জাতিক শিল্প বন্দর (Haldia Industrial Seaport)
local_entities.description: Major deep-water dock complex and petrochemical industrial hub situated at the confluence of the Haldi and Hooghly rivers.

authenticity.note: Key economic geography topic in Class 10 WBBSE Madhyamik syllabus.

local_entities.name_bengali: দিঘার সমুদ্র সৈকত ও ঝাউবন (Digha Marine Beach & Casuarina Forest)
local_entities.description: Flat, wide hard-sand marine beach bordered by Casuarina (ঝাউ গাছ) windbreaks along the Bay of Bengal.

authenticity.note: Universal geographical feature known to every student in Bengal.

local_entities.name_bengali: ঘাটালের কাঁসা-পিতল শিল্প (Ghatal Brass & Bell Metalwork)
local_entities.description: Traditional hand-hammered bronze and bell-metal cookware, temple utensils, and dinner plates (কাঁসার থালা-বাটি).

authenticity.note: Classic chemistry of alloys and history of metallurgy in school science.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Soil Erosion & Contour Farming (মৃত্তিকা ক্ষয় ও ধাপ চাষ)
substitutions.description: Using Darjeeling tea garden slope contour bunds to explain water runoff velocity reduction.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Inclined Plane & Frictional Resistance (নততল ও ঘর্ষণ)
substitutions.description: Explaining the mechanical advantage of switchbacks (Zigzag loops) at Batasia loop on the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway.
disanalogy_flags: Train mass uses friction for adhesion, whereas ideal inclined plane models treat surfaces as frictionless.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Compound Growth & Percentage Yield (চক্রবৃদ্ধি হার ও উৎপাদন বৃদ্ধি)
substitutions.description: Arithmetic problem calculating annual yield growth in a Kalimpong large cardamom cooperative.
Using the biological process of jute retting in ponds to explain microbial enzymatic breakdown of pectin.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Current Flow in Closed Circuits (তড়িৎ প্রবাহ ও রোধ)
substitutions.description: Comparing electric potential and water height in DVC irrigation channels with sluice gates as resistors.
disanalogy_flags: Water particles accumulate mass and inertia; electric current involves electron drift with instantaneous field propagation.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Profit, Loss & Storage Depreciation (লাভ ও ক্ষতি)
substitutions.description: Word problem involving storage rent and selling price per quintal of Jyoti potato in Hooghly.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Composite Materials & Layering (মিশ্র পদার্থ ও স্তরবিন্যাস)
substitutions.description: Explaining tensile strength in layered paper-mache, clay and glue in Purulia Chhau masks.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Potential Energy to Kinetic Energy Conversion (স্থিতিশক্তি থেকে গতিশক্তি)
substitutions.description: Explaining conversion of high-head stored water energy into electrical energy at Maithon hydel plant.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Soil Porosity & Water Retention Capacity (মাটির জলধারণ ক্ষমতা)
substitutions.description: Comparing water percolation rates between Purulia red laterite and Gangetic clay loam.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Plant Respiration in Oxygen-Depleted Soil (উদ্ভিদের শ্বাসকার্য ও মূলীয় অভিযোজন)
substitutions.description: Explaining negative geotropism and lenticels in Sundari tree breathing roots in waterlogged saline mud.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Relative Velocity & Vector Addition (আপেক্ষিক বেগ ও ভেক্টর যোগ)
substitutions.description: Calculating resulting boat trajectory across the Matla river during incoming high tide (জোয়ারের টান).
disanalogy_flags: Water current profile varies across depth, whereas basic vector kinematics assumes uniform velocity.

substitutions.canonical_concept: Liquid Pressure & Depth Proportionality (তরলের চাপ = h * d * g)
substitutions.description: Calculating hydrostatic lateral force exerted on the base of a Sundarban river dyke during a 5-meter spring tide.
